title: rewardBudget reset to full balance on every recompute double-counts already-accrued rewards, over-committing emissions and DoSing late claimers
asset_impact: Accrued-but-unclaimed rewards of late claimers can be frozen until owner top-up. Principal always recoverable via emergencyWithdraw.
attack_path:
1. Alice stakes at t=0; rewardBudget set to balance.
2. Time passes; Alice accrues pending rewards, balance unchanged because no interaction has fired _updatePool or a claim.
3. Bob stakes: _syncBudget runs _updatePool (commits Alice's accrual to accRewardPerShare and decrements rewardBudget), then _recomputeSchedule overwrites rewardBudget back to balance (which still includes Alice's committed rewards). windowEnd extended.
4. Over the next window, accRewardPerShare advances against a budget that was already partially spent on paper.
5. First claimer is paid; later claimers hit _safePay shortfall and revert. Earned rewards frozen until owner tops up or users take emergencyWithdraw (forfeiting rewards).
likelihood: medium - no special privilege required; triggered by natural user activity (stake/unstake/claim/topUp/pullAndRefresh) over time. Requires pending accrual to sit uncommitted-to-balance between recomputes, which is the default state between interactions.
assumptions: Pool sees multiple recompute-triggering interactions between a given staker's accrual and their claim. Reward balance does not grow fast enough via pull() / topUp to absorb the over-commitment.
external_requirements: None external. All triggers are in-protocol.
justification: Assets not directly at risk (principal safe via emergencyWithdraw) but protocol solvency invariant is broken and claim availability is impacted for late claimers — value leak with stated assumptions, textbook C4 Medium.
